scores.reason: Batch Bayesian optimization for hyperparameter tuning. No relation to neural network training, Muon, or batch-size scaling in standard deep learning.
Physics/muon colliders. Not related to the optimizer or neural network training.
Particle accelerator physics. No connection to deep learning or optimization algorithms.
Muon collider design in high-energy physics. Not related to neural network optimization.

Covers batch-size and learning-rate scaling, but for Adam-style optimizers, not Muon or orthogonalized methods. Shows Adam scales differently than SGD, which is tangentially relevant but doesn't address the orthogonalized-update case or short horizons.
Muon applied to distributed LLM pretraining (150M–914M models). Likely falls under excluded category: LLM-pretraining-only without evidence that findings transfer to CIFAR-100 short-horizon regime.

Directly addresses critical batch size for Muon vs AdamW and retains data efficiency beyond critical batch size. Reports practical Pareto frontiers. However, focused on large-scale pretraining; abstract does not clarify whether short-horizon CIFAR experiments are included or whether concrete lr/wd scaling rules are provided.
Theoretical analysis of Muon's design principle via surrogate quadratic model. No coverage of batch-size scaling, short horizons, or practical scaling rules.
Hamiltonian gradient-flow analysis of Muon. Theoretical perspective without empirical batch-size scaling or short-horizon training coverage.
Convergence rate theory for Muon. Does not address batch-size scaling, critical batch size, or practical hyperparameter rescaling.
Muon-C: operator-aligned variant for convolutions. Tests on CIFAR-10 flow matching but does not address batch-size scaling or short-horizon hyperparameter rescaling.
Spectral-aware Muon for physics-informed neural networks. Different application domain (PINNs); no coverage of standard supervised learning, batch-size scaling, or CIFAR-like regimes.
Convergence analysis of variance-reduced Muon with weight decay and mini-batches. Theoretical treatment with no empirical batch-size scaling experiments or short-horizon training scenarios.
Analyzes simplicity bias of Muon on deep linear networks and linear attention. Theoretical limitations paper; no batch-size scaling, critical batch size, or CIFAR experiments.
Proposes adaptive optimizer interpolating SGD and Muon via Schatten-p norms. No empirical coverage of batch-size scaling or short-horizon training.
River-valley theory of Muon's strengths and limitations in LLM training. Focused on theoretical characterization of large-scale pretraining; no batch-size scaling or short-horizon coverage.
Muon applied to adversarial training. Different task domain; no relevance to batch-size scaling on clean supervised learning (CIFAR-100).
Sign-Muon for distributed training with 1-bit communication. Excluded per RULES: multi-GPU distributed communication papers whose gains stem from communication efficiency, not optimization dynamics.
Accelerates Muon's orthogonalization step via pre-conditioning. Reports wall-clock speedups but does not address batch-size scaling, critical batch size, or hyperparameter rescaling rules.
Low-bit Muon quantization framework. Addresses quantization-error fidelity, not batch-size scaling, critical batch size, or short-horizon hyperparameter rescaling.
